mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM dual

SELECT c.COUNTRY_CODE AS countryCode, c.NAME_KO AS nameKo, s.BIRTHS AS births, s.LIFE_EXPECTANCY AS lifeExpectancy, s.INFANT_MORTALITY AS infantMortality, s.U5_MORTALITY AS u5Mortality, s.GDP_PER_CAPITA AS gdpPerCapita, s.URBAN_RATE AS urbanRate, s.SEX_RATIO_BIRTH AS sexRatioBirth FROM COUNTRY c JOIN COUNTRY_STAT s ON c.COUNTRY_CODE = s.COUNTRY_CODE WHERE c.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND s.DECADE = #{decade} AND s.BIRTHS > 0
SELECT SEQ_LIFE.NEXTVAL FROM dual
mapper.update: UPDATE LIFE SET STATUS = 'ABANDONED', ENDED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE GUEST_TOKEN = #{guestToken} AND STATUS = 'PLAYING'
UPDATE LIFE SET STATUS = 'ABANDONED', ENDED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'PLAYING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GUEST_LIFE_STAT (STAT_ID, BIRTH_COUNTRY, BIRTH_YEAR, GENDER, STATUS, DEATH_AGE, STARTED_AT, ENDED_AT) SELECT SEQ_GUEST_LIFE_STAT.NEXTVAL, BIRTH_COUNTRY, BIRTH_YEAR, GENDER, STATUS, DEATH_AGE, CREATED_AT, ENDED_AT FROM LIFE WHERE MEMBER_ID IS NULL AND (LAST_PLAYED_AT < SYSDATE - 7 OR (STATUS <> 'PLAYING' AND LAST_PLAYED_AT < SYSDATE - 1))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM LIFE WHERE MEMBER_ID IS NULL AND (LAST_PLAYED_AT < SYSDATE - 7 OR (STATUS <> 'PLAYING' AND LAST_PLAYED_AT < SYSDATE - 1))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LIFE ( LIFE_ID, MEMBER_ID, GUEST_TOKEN, START_TYPE, NAME, GENDER, BIRTH_COUNTRY, CURRENT_COUNTRY, BIRTH_YEAR, WEALTH_CLASS, ORIGIN_CLASS, IS_URBAN, HEALTH, HAPPINESS, KNOWLEDGE, RELATION ) VALUES ( #{lifeId}, #{memberId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{guestToken, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{startType}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{birthCountry}, #{currentCountry}, #{birthYear}, #{wealthClass}, #{wealthClass}, #{isUrban}, #{health}, #{happiness}, #{knowledge}, #{relation} )
mapper.select: SELECT LIFE_ID AS lifeId, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, GUEST_TOKEN AS guestToken, START_TYPE AS startType, NAME AS name, GENDER AS gender, BIRTH_COUNTRY AS birthCountry, CURRENT_COUNTRY AS currentCountry, BIRTH_YEAR AS birthYear, WEALTH_CLASS AS wealthClass, IS_URBAN AS isUrban, CURRENT_AGE AS currentAge, HEALTH AS health, HAPPINESS AS happiness, KNOWLEDGE AS knowledge, RELATION AS relation, IS_MARRIED AS marriedYn, CHILD_COUNT AS childCount, PARENT_ALIVE AS parentAlive, EDU_LEVEL AS eduLevel, SCHOOL_STATUS AS schoolStatus, DROP_REASON AS dropReason, JOB_ID AS jobId, JOB_STATUS AS jobStatus, JOB_YEARS AS jobYears, PREP_SCORE AS prepScore, INCOME_RATE AS incomeRate, NVL(INCOME, 0) AS income, NVL(ASSETS, 0) AS assets, PENSION AS pension, STAGE_CODE AS stageCode, FOCUS_CODE AS focusCode, PENDING_EVENT_ID AS pendingEventId, INVEST_TYPE AS investType, OWNS AS owns, NVL(ORIGIN_CLASS, WEALTH_CLASS) AS originClass, HOUSE_VALUE AS houseValue, STATUS AS status FROM LIFE WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE LIFE SET CURRENT_AGE = #{currentAge}, CURRENT_COUNTRY = #{currentCountry}, IS_MARRIED = NVL(#{marriedYn, jdbcType=CHAR}, 'N'), CHILD_COUNT = #{childCount}, PARENT_ALIVE = NVL(#{parentAlive, jdbcType=CHAR}, 'Y'), HEALTH = #{health}, HAPPINESS = #{happiness}, KNOWLEDGE = #{knowledge}, RELATION = #{relation}, EDU_LEVEL = #{eduLevel}, SCHOOL_STATUS = #{schoolStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DROP_REASON = #{dropReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, JOB_ID = #{jobId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, JOB_STATUS = #{jobStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, JOB_YEARS = #{jobYears}, PREP_SCORE = #{prepScore}, INCOME_RATE = #{incomeRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, INCOME = #{income}, ASSETS = #{assets}, PENSION = #{pension, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, STAGE_CODE = #{stageCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FOCUS_CODE = #{focusCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PENDING_EVENT_ID = #{pendingEventId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, OWNS = #{owns, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, WEALTH_CLASS = #{wealthClass}, ORIGIN_CLASS = #{originClass, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, HOUSE_VALUE = #{houseValue, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, LAST_PLAYED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT s.COUNTRY_CODE AS countryCode, c.NAME_KO AS nameKo, c.REGION_CODE AS regionCode, s.LIFE_EXPECTANCY AS lifeExpectancy, s.INFANT_MORTALITY AS infantMortality, s.U5_MORTALITY AS u5Mortality, s.GDP_PER_CAPITA AS gdpPerCapita FROM COUNTRY_STAT s JOIN COUNTRY c ON s.COUNTRY_CODE = c.COUNTRY_CODE WHERE s.COUNTRY_CODE = #{currentCountry} ORDER BY ABS(s.DECADE - TRUNC((#{birthYear} + #{currentAge}) / 10) * 10) ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE LIFE SET STATUS = 'ENDED', DEATH_AGE = #{deathAge}, DEATH_CAUSE = #{deathCause}, AVG_INCOME = #{avgIncome, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, LIFE_SCORE = #{lifeScore, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, INCOME_TOP_PCT = #{incomeTopPct, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, ENDED_AT = SYSDATE, LAST_PLAYED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId}

UPDATE LIFE SET HEALTH = #{health}, HAPPINESS = #{happiness}, KNOWLEDGE = #{knowledge}, RELATION = #{relation}, ASSETS = #{assets}, INVEST_TYPE = #{investType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, OWNS = #{owns, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HOUSE_VALUE = #{houseValue, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, LAST_PLAYED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} AND STATUS = 'PLAYING'
UPDATE LIFE SET FOCUS_CODE = #{focusCode}, LAST_PLAYED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LIFE_EXPERIENCE (LIFE_ID, EXP_ID, AGE, YEAR_NO) SELECT #{lifeId}, #{expId}, #{age}, #{yearNo} FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LIFE_EXPERIENCE WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} AND EXP_ID = #{expId} AND AGE = #{age})
mapper.update: UPDATE LIFE SET CURRENT_AGE = CURRENT_AGE WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} AND CURRENT_AGE = #{currentAge} AND STATUS = 'PLAYING' AND PENDING_EVENT_ID IS NULL
UPDATE LIFE SET PENDING_EVENT_ID = PENDING_EVENT_ID WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} AND PENDING_EVENT_ID = #{pendingEventId} AND STATUS = 'PLAYING'
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(G.INTENSITY, 1) AS intensity, T.JOB_LOSS_ADD AS jobLossAdd, T.EDU_STOP_ADD AS eduStopAdd, T.MIGRATE_ADD AS migrateAdd, T.TYPE_NAME AS typeName, G.HIST_TYPE_CODE AS typeCode FROM GAME_EVENT G JOIN HIST_EVENT_TYPE T ON G.HIST_TYPE_CODE = T.TYPE_CODE WHERE G.EVENT_ID = #{eventId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LIFE_TRAIT (LIFE_ID, TRAIT_ID, TRAIT_LEVEL) SELECT #{lifeId}, T.TRAIT_ID, NVL(M.TRAIT_LEVEL, 1) FROM TRAIT T LEFT JOIN MEMBER_TRAIT M ON M.TRAIT_ID = T.TRAIT_ID AND M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
mapper.select: SELECT L.TRAIT_ID AS traitId, L.TRAIT_LEVEL AS "level", E.EFFECT_VALUE AS effect FROM LIFE_TRAIT L LEFT JOIN TRAIT_LEVEL_EFFECT E ON E.TRAIT_ID = L.TRAIT_ID AND E.LEVEL_NO = L.TRAIT_LEVEL WHERE L.LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} ORDER BY L.TRAIT_ID

SELECT NVL(E.EFFECT_VALUE, (L.TRAIT_LEVEL - 1) * 0.25) FROM LIFE_TRAIT L LEFT JOIN TRAIT_LEVEL_EFFECT E ON E.TRAIT_ID = L.TRAIT_ID AND E.LEVEL_NO = L.TRAIT_LEVEL WHERE L.LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} AND L.TRAIT_ID = 'STUDY'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LIFE_EVENT_LOG (LOG_ID, LIFE_ID, AGE, YEAR_NO, EVENT_ID, CHOICE_ID, LOG_TEXT, IS_AI) VALUES (SEQ_LIFE_EVENT_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{lifeId}, #{age}, #{yearNo}, #{eventId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{choiceId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{logText}, #{isAi})
mapper.select: SELECT l.AGE FROM LIFE_EVENT_LOG l LEFT JOIN EVENT_CHOICE c ON c.CHOICE_ID = l.CHOICE_ID LEFT JOIN GAME_EVENT g ON g.EVENT_ID = l.EVENT_ID LEFT JOIN EVENT_TEMPLATE t ON t.TEMPLATE_ID = g.TEMPLATE_ID WHERE l.LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} AND l.EVENT_ID IS NOT NULL AND ((l.CHOICE_ID IS NOT NULL AND c.RESULT_ACTION = 'CHILD') OR (l.CHOICE_ID IS NULL AND t.RESULT_ACTION = 'CHILD' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EVENT_CHOICE x WHERE x.EVENT_ID = l.EVENT_ID))) ORDER BY l.AGE, l.LOG_ID

SELECT L.LIFE_ID AS lifeId, L.AGE AS age, L.YEAR_NO AS yearNo, L.EVENT_ID AS eventId, L.CHOICE_ID AS choiceId, L.LOG_TEXT AS logText, L.IS_AI AS isAi, G.EVENT_TYPE AS eventType, CASE WHEN G.EVENT_TYPE = 'HIST' AND L.CHOICE_ID IS NULL AND (NVL(G.INTENSITY, 1) >= 2 OR G.HIST_TYPE_CODE IN ('WAR', 'DISASTER')) AND L.LOG_TEXT NOT LIKE '%끝났%' AND L.LOG_TEXT NOT LIKE '%멎었%' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS alert FROM LIFE_EVENT_LOG L LEFT JOIN GAME_EVENT G ON L.EVENT_ID = G.EVENT_ID WHERE L.LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} ORDER BY L.AGE DESC, L.LOG_ID ASC

SELECT AGE AS age, YEAR_NO AS yearNo, COUNTRY_CODE AS countryCode, HEALTH AS health, HAPPINESS AS happiness, KNOWLEDGE AS knowledge, RELATION AS relation, FOCUS_CODE AS focusCode, JOB_ID AS jobId, NVL(INCOME, 0) AS income, NVL(ASSETS, 0) AS assets FROM LIFE_YEAR_LOG WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} ORDER BY AGE

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT s.COUNTRY_CODE AS countryCode, c.NAME_KO AS nameKo, g.REGION_NAME AS regionName, s.DECADE AS decade, s.POPULATION AS population, s.BIRTHS AS births, s.DEATHS AS deaths, s.LIFE_EXPECTANCY AS lifeExpectancy, s.INFANT_MORTALITY AS infantMortality, s.U5_MORTALITY AS u5Mortality, s.GDP_PER_CAPITA AS gdpPerCapita, s.URBAN_RATE AS urbanRate, s.SEX_RATIO_BIRTH AS sexRatioBirth, s.TFR AS tfr, s.UNEMPLOYMENT_RATE AS unemploymentRate, s.NET_MIGRATION_RATE AS netMigrationRate, s.IS_ESTIMATED AS isEstimated, d.TITLE AS sourceTitle FROM COUNTRY_STAT s JOIN COUNTRY c ON s.COUNTRY_CODE = c.COUNTRY_CODE LEFT JOIN REGION g ON g.REGION_CODE = c.REGION_CODE LEFT JOIN DATA_SOURCE d ON d.SOURCE_ID = s.SOURCE_ID WHERE s.COUNTRY_CODE = #{countryCode} ORDER BY ABS(s.DECADE - TRUNC(#{year} / 10) * 10) ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT r.ENROLL_ELEM AS enrollElem, r.ENROLL_MIDDLE AS enrollMiddle, r.ENROLL_HIGH AS enrollHigh, r.ENROLL_UNI AS enrollUni, r.AGRI_RATE AS agriRate, r.INDUSTRY_RATE AS industryRate, r.SERVICE_RATE AS serviceRate FROM REGION_STAT r JOIN COUNTRY c ON r.REGION_CODE = c.REGION_CODE WHERE c.COUNTRY_CODE = #{currentCountry} ORDER BY ABS(r.DECADE - TRUNC((#{birthYear} + #{currentAge}) / 10) * 10) ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT JOB_ID AS jobId, JOB_NAME AS jobName, REQUIRED_EDU AS requiredEdu, INDUSTRY AS industry, INCOME_RATE AS incomeRate FROM JOB

SELECT q.QUEST_ID AS questId, q.QUEST_NAME AS questName, q.DESCRIPTION AS description, lq.ACHIEVED AS achieved, q.QUEST_TYPE AS questType, q.TARGET_VALUE AS targetValue FROM LIFE_QUEST lq JOIN QUEST q ON q.QUEST_ID = lq.QUEST_ID WHERE lq.LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} ORDER BY q.QUEST_ID
SELECT JOB_ID AS jobId, JOB_NAME AS jobName, REQUIRED_EDU AS requiredEdu, INDUSTRY AS industry, INCOME_RATE AS incomeRate FROM JOB WHERE JOB_ID = #{jobId}
SELECT ROUND(AVG(INCOME)) FROM ( SELECT INCOME FROM LIFE_YEAR_LOG WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId} AND INCOME > 0 UNION ALL SELECT #{income} FROM dual WHERE #{income} > 0 )

SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN s.GDP_PER_CAPITA < #{avgIncome} THEN s.POPULATION ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(s.POPULATION), 0) FROM COUNTRY_STAT s JOIN COUNTRY c ON s.COUNTRY_CODE = c.COUNTRY_CODE WHERE c.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND s.POPULATION IS NOT NULL AND s.GDP_PER_CAPITA IS NOT NULL AND s.DECADE = ( SELECT DECADE FROM ( SELECT DECADE FROM COUNTRY_STAT ORDER BY ABS(DECADE - TRUNC((#{birthYear} + #{currentAge}) / 10) * 10) ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 )
